description:
Long-poll this account's fact-write events instead of re-scanning with since_epoch. Every store/supersede/delete/archive/restore/move publishes one event {key, id, namespace, layer, op, ts, seq}. One call waits up to max_wait_s (max 25) for the first matching event and returns up to 50, plus next_since. MCP has no streaming here, so loop: pass next_since back as `since` on the next call and nothing is missed (the server keeps the last ~10000 events per account). Omit since to start from now; since=0 replays what is retained; a bare integer N returns events with seq > N.

EXAMPLES
- Wait for hands to post results:
    watch_events(prefix='task:pr27-review:result:', max_wait_s=25)
- Resume:
    watch_events(prefix='comms:<your-agent-id>:', since='<next_since>')

Inside a workspace only events for keys the grant can read are returned. Long-lived clients can use GET /api/v1/events (SSE) instead.

max_wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the first event (0-25, default 20).

prefix.description: Only events whose key starts with this prefix.

since.description: Resume cursor: the next_since of the previous call (a stream id '<ms>-<n>'), '0' for everything retained, or a seq integer. Omit to start from now.

name: watch_events
title: Watch Events (long-poll fact writes)
